name: Laurence Fox
role: Actor, broadcaster and founder of the Reclaim Party
summary: Fox advocates expansive speech rights, cultural conservatism, tougher policing and opposition to lockdowns and climate restrictions. He promotes national heritage and assimilation, opposes gender-identity teaching, and has made exclusionary statements about Islam while professing respect for Muslim individuals.

notes:
Read the complete 2021 personal manifesto, full available interviews and transcripts, and later 2026 election statements; reviewed all 490 statements. His political record merits a full audit despite his acting career. Transcripts contain multiple speakers: Peterson’s nuclear proposals, Clouston’s nationalization and tariff proposals, and Calvin Robinson’s religious policies are not Fox’s. Fox’s own 2024 call to remove Islam is documented separately from Robinson’s similar remarks; it does not by itself specify deportation of all Muslim citizens or a criminal penalty for worship. Later claims of love for Muslim individuals are retained as mixed evidence, not used to erase the exclusionary statement. A not-guilty plea does not establish guilt or a policy reversal. Age-specific sex-education objections are not an opposition to all factual biology teaching. Mocking Pride, working with conservative Christians or denouncing abortion advocates does not establish his position on gay marriage, adult same-sex criminalization or abortion law. General small-state language does not establish a specific tax schedule or abolition of healthcare. No inferred answers.
